questionText:
A machine receives an IPv4 datagram. The protocol field of the IPv4 header has the protocol number of a protocol X.

Which ONE of the following is NOT a possible candidate for X?
explanation:
Step-by-step Explanation:

• ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol): Encapsulated directly inside IPv4 datagrams with protocol number $1$.

• IGMP (Internet Group Management Protocol): Encapsulated directly inside IPv4 datagrams with protocol number $2$.

• OSPF (Open Shortest Path First): Encapsulated directly inside IPv4 datagrams with protocol number $89$.

• RIP (Routing Information Protocol): Operates at the application layer and runs on top of UDP using port $520$. Therefore, the IPv4 header protocol field carries the protocol number for UDP ($17$), not RIP.

Hence, RIP is NOT a candidate for X, making Option (D) the correct answer.
